whoTheyAre.summary: The live source identifies Japanese in Japan and ties the record to Japanese (jpn). Glottolog independently identifies Japanese as a national language, while scholarship documents both the historical construction of Standard Japanese and the persistence of regional and social linguistic diversity.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org supplies an aggregate 'Ethnoreligion - Shinbutso-shugo' label for this record. It is retained as source-level mission context and is not generalized into a statement about the belief or practice of every Japanese person.

profile.whyUnreachedIntro: The current mission classification is explained only from PeopleGroups.org source-native fields. Japanese nationality, language standardization, cultural identity and the provider religion label are not treated as causes of unreached status.

whyUnreached.heading: Current source mission status

whyUnreached.heading: Reported resources remain narrower than actual access

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record PG007559 reports PEID 7559, display name Japanese, country Japan and primary language Japanese (jpn).
Glottolog identifies Japanese with glottocode nucl1643 and ISO 639-3 code jpn and records Japanese as a de facto national language.
claims.interpretationNote: National-language status is an institutional language-level statement and does not imply a uniform personal identity or exclusive language use.

claims.text: Scholarship on modern Japan documents the historical construction and promotion of Standard Japanese as a national language while also describing regional and social varieties that are obscured by a single-language national narrative.
claims.interpretationNote: This is institutional and linguistic history, not a claim that every Japanese person relates to language or national identity in the same way.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record reports 'Ethnoreligion - Shinbutso-shugo' as the aggregate primary-religion label for PG007559.
claims.interpretationNote: This is a provider classification for one people-group-in-country record, not a statement about every Japanese person's belief or practice.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record reports GSEC 1, less than 2% evangelical presence and no recent church-planting activity for PG007559; it separately reports Engaged status and existing congregations.
claims.interpretationNote: These are source-native mission-research fields for one people-group-in-country record, not a judgment about individuals.

claims.text: The live structured record reports Bible availability as Available, Jesus Film availability as Available and five total evangelical resources for PG007559.
claims.interpretationNote: Provider availability fields do not establish distribution, comprehension, use or translation completeness.
